why: The candidate set the worked example on docs/concepts/placement.md walks. Built rather than sampled: it fires every term of the stage-1 score at least once, which no real day is guaranteed to do, and it holds the case the page exists to explain - a story with the best source losing to a story carrying every bonus we can pay. It ran the other way until 2026-09-13, when carriage stopped multiplying authority and became a flat step, and that reversal is what the page uses to show the difference.

stories.name: A ministry statement a wire service also carried
stories.shows: Carriage adds one flat step to the authority term. Nothing else fires. It DOUBLED that term until 2026-09-13, which is what used to put this story first.

stories.name: A trade-press scoop on a watchlist company
stories.shows: Every bonus fires at once: watchlist, the heaviest lens, and an hour-old story's recency.

stories.name: A community post on a feed we turned down
stories.shows: Both multipliers below 1.0 at once - a hand-set feed weight and a reliability factor the ledger derived.
